Done: Clear your first camp
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-1, 4)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 1750 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (2, 0)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 1400 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.
